note: Map points for the Explore Nepal map. Peaks come from the expeditions database (they carry their own coordinates); these are the towns, trailheads, passes, cultural sites and lakes. Positions are to the nearest few hundred metres — good for a country-scale map, not for navigation. The Rolwaling entries (Singati & Chetchet, Beding, Tsho Rolpa, Tashi Lapcha) were added 2026-09-18 from published figures and are worth a check against your own GPS tracks.

places.name: Lumbini
places.note: Birthplace of the Buddha, on the Terai plain.

places.name: Muktinath
places.note: Pilgrimage temple below the Thorong La, sacred to Hindus and Buddhists.

places.name: Lo Manthang
places.note: Walled capital of Upper Mustang, behind the Himalaya.

places.name: Pokhara
places.note: Lakeside gateway to the Annapurna trails.

places.name: Gorkha
places.note: Hill fort where the unification of Nepal began.

places.name: Kathmandu
places.note: Where every trip starts: permits, briefings and the flight or drive to the trailhead.

places.name: Patan
places.note: Durbar Square, metalworkers and courtyards south of the river.

places.name: Bhaktapur
places.note: Newar city of brick and wood, east of Kathmandu.

places.name: Janakpur
places.note: Mithila city of temples and painted houses.

places.name: Beding
places.note: The Sherpa village at the head of the Rolwaling valley, under Gauri Shankar.

places.name: Tengboche
places.note: The Khumbu's principal monastery, facing Ama Dablam.

places.name: Simikot
places.note: Humla's airstrip, the way to Limi and the Tibet border.

places.name: Dunai
places.note: Dolpo's district town, below Phoksundo.

places.name: Jomsom
places.note: Windy Kali Gandaki town, airstrip and the road to Mustang.

places.name: Nayapul & Birethanti
places.note: Trailhead for Annapurna Base Camp and the Ghorepani hills.

places.name: Besisahar
places.note: Road head for the Annapurna Circuit.

places.name: Soti Khola
places.note: Start of the Budhi Gandaki gorge into Manaslu and Tsum.

places.name: Syabrubesi
places.note: Bus from Kathmandu, then straight up the Langtang valley.

places.name: Singati & Chetchet
places.note: Road head for Rolwaling — the jeep from Charikot ends here and the valley walk begins.

places.name: Phaplu & Salleri
places.note: Solu road head — the slow, quiet way into the Khumbu.

places.name: Namche Bazaar
places.note: Sherpa town and the acclimatisation stop of the Everest trails.

places.name: Lukla
places.note: The Khumbu airstrip: step off the plane and start walking.

places.name: Taplejung
places.note: Far-eastern road head for Kanchenjunga.

places.name: Thorong La

places.name: Larke La
places.note: The crossing that closes the Manaslu Circuit.

places.name: Ganja La

places.name: Tashi Lapcha

places.name: Renjo La
places.note: West of Gokyo, with the finest view back to Everest.

places.name: Cho La

places.name: Kongma La
places.note: The highest and quietest of the Three Passes.

places.name: Bardia National Park

places.name: Rara Lake

places.name: Phoksundo Lake
places.note: The turquoise lake of Lower Dolpo.

places.name: Tilicho Lake
places.note: One of the highest large lakes in the world.

places.name: Chitwan National Park

places.name: Langtang Valley
places.note: Yak pastures and glaciers a day's drive from Kathmandu.

places.name: Tsho Rolpa

places.name: Gokyo Lakes
